notes.title: Update V1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi,
We'd like to express our apologies for the bugs and issues you had to endure in the first release of the game. We are a 3 person indie studio and this is the first game we have developed with extremely limited resources. We have learned a tremendous amount from all your reviews and feedback.

We want to correct all of the bugs you have encountered. The first update fixes the following issues:

Improved lighting and camera effects (including bloom and tone mapping)
Improved rendering quality
Smoother and easier gameplay
Optimized alien bullet and particle effects
Improved health system, slow motion and death camera filters
Improved accuracy and spread of AK47 and Shotgun
Performance improvements
Improved object visibility and reduced blur


What's Next?

We are working hard to improve our rendering and lighting quality
We have outsourced the voice acting
To show our appreciation for all your feedback, we will add a multiplayer level to the game.


Please continue to send us any and all feedback. We will do our best to implement them as soon as possible.
Once again, thank you all very much for your assistance and support.

Sincerely,
Appsolutely Studios
